defects: Minor, not blocking: /home/main/.cache/yard/vqa-r4/dirt_full8x.png the 'hollow + grey pebble pair' motif recurs three times (8x (550,165)/(530,220), (165,550)/(145,605), (1060,680)/(1050,735)) and the pebble pair repeats at 16px spacing at (840,545)/(970,545); spread out enough not to read as a stamp at 4x.
Minor: /home/main/.cache/yard/vqa-r4/dirt_neck.png south bank lip notches repeat every 16px along straight runs (8x y~350 and y~990), expected from the single edge tile and not objectionable at 4x.
evidence: r3 edge stamping is fixed: straight edge tiles no longer carry clods/straw/pebbles, so long edges are plain tufted grass rims (N/W/E) and a darker south bank lip. Body is a fine 4-tone red-brown dither with sparse clods lit top-left, straw dashes and shallow hollows distributed irregularly; 16px self-similarity 51/42% vs 42-45% at 4/8px, so no cell lattice. Hole, corners, neck and isolated mound join cleanly. Colour is clearly redder than Beodeul sand and sits next to the stone house in compare-3x at chipset quality.
